create_SGD_optimizer: create an SGD optimizer with a learning rate and momentum for PyTorch model parameters
run_SGD_step: run a single optimization step using the SGD optimizer to update model parameters
build_SGD_with_nesterov: build an SGD optimizer with Nesterov momentum enabled for accelerated gradient descent
test_SGD_weight_decay: test the SGD optimizer with weight decay regularization applied to model parameters
review_SGD_step: review the SGD optimizer step method that updates parameters using gradients and momentum
